newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's TBC rate cut to 1.70 pct for January.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's TBC rate cut to 1.70 pct for January.

text.p: Brazil's Monetary Policy Committee of the Central Bank (Copom) said it has cut the Basic Interest Rate of the Central Bank (TBC) to 1.70 percent for January from 1.74 percent in December.
The Copom also cut the Rate of Assistance of the Central Bank (TBAN) at 1.88 percent for January from 1.90 percent this month.

The TBC, which is set on a monthly basis and was first introduced in July, is used as a reference rate for Central Bank rediscount loans and PROER credit lines granted for banks in the process of mergers and acquisitions.
The TBAN is a rediscount line rate for Central Bank financial assistance to banks.
